subject: Oakbridge — demo timing: align with CFO reforecast
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@oakbridge.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Bianchi <mbianchi@oakbridge.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Sep 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Oakbridge — initial demo request

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the intro earlier — Oakbridge is interested in a focused demo of Redwood for inference cost controls and dedicated capacity. We were aiming to get something on the calendar next week.

A couple constraints to flag up front: our CFO is pushing a reforecast exercise starting the first week of October, and several stakeholders will be in transit (EMEA customer visits). If possible we'd like a short, executive-aligned slot that shows: latency/throughput guarantees, cost controls (Optimize recommendations), and how Dedicated/Private mapping would look for our workloads.

Availability (Oakbridge): Tue 30 Sep 09:00–12:00 PT, Wed 1 Oct 13:00–17:00 PT, Fri 3 Oct all day.

Can you propose 2 options and the expected attendee list on your side?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Data Platforms | Oakbridge Analytics
elena.rossi@oakbridge.ai
+1 415 555 0123
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@oakbridge.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Sep 2025 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Oakbridge — initial demo request

Hi Elena — really appreciate the detail. Priya (solutions) and Hannah (dedicated sales) are copied.

We're happy to accommodate a short executive + tech demo. Proposed options (30–45m):
- Tue 30 Sep 09:30 PT — Exec intro (Vivek) + 20m tech walkthrough (Priya)
- Wed 1 Oct 15:00 PT — Deep-dive (45m) with dedicated capacity scenarios (Hannah)

If the CFO/finance folks will be in the reforecast cadence and prefer post-reforecast, we can also look at Tue 7 Oct or Wed 8 Oct same windows.

Attached is a very short Mutual Action Plan (one-pager) and a draft quote so you can see the cost bands we typically discuss. If you need a different audience mix, let us know and we will adjust.

Best,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Attachment: Oakbridge-MAP-v1.pdf (one-pager), proposal-oakbridge-quote.xlsx
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@oakbridge.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Oakbridge — initial demo request

Vivek — thank you, that is helpful detail. Quick update: CFO has asked us to hold major procurement conversations until the internal reforecast completes (they want to rebaseline FY25 run-rate in early Oct). Also, Marco and two of our platform engineers will be traveling to London from 2–9 Oct, which reduces their availability.

We prefer to push the demo to the week of 13 Oct when the finance window has closed and our stakeholders are back. Can we tentatively target Tue 14 Oct 10:00 PT / 18:00 BST? That would give your team time to tailor the deep-dive toward spend-reduction levers and Dedicated sizing.

If that works for you, please send a calendar invite and updated MAP reflecting the reschedule.

Best,
Elena
P.S. please keep the quote on file; we expect to re-engage quickly after reforecast.
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@oakbridge.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Oct 2025 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Oakbridge — initial demo request (rescheduled)

Elena / Marco — thanks for the heads up and the timeline. We can absolutely shift to Tue 14 Oct 10:00 PT. I've penciled the slot and asked Priya to prepare a focused section on batching/caching and Optimize recommendations that map to your historical token distribution (will include back-of-envelope unit economics). Hannah will have Dedicated sizing options and a quick SLA breakdown.

I've attached an updated MAP that reflects the revised milestones and a calendar invite link (below). Once you confirm attendee names for the 14th we'll finalize the invite and include the one-pager and quote.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=oakbridge_demo_20251014
Updated MAP: Oakbridge-MAP-v1.pdf
Quote: proposal-oakbridge-quote.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Vivek
